usedFor: ikas holds your store’s orders and products, and Google Drive holds their files, handled by “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in ikas, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: It copies a Drive file into a chosen folder with an optional new name, giving every order a document.

watchOut: “Order Updated” in ikas fires on every order change, and “Share File With Anyone” opens a link, so check access.
